proof_body:
by
  intro a z ha hz
  have hne : 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have h2 : ‖a‖ * ‖z‖ = 1 := by
      have := congrArg norm h1
      simpa using this
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg z]
  have h3 : (1 : ℂ) - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have h2 : ‖a‖ * ‖a‖ = 1 := by
      have := congrArg norm h1
      simpa using this
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
  have e1 : (z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z) + a = z * (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z) := by
    rw [div_add' _ _ _ hne]
    congr 1
    ring
  have e2 : 1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) a * ((z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z)) = (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z) := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', add_div' _ _ _ hne]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [e1, e2, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hne, mul_div_cancel_right₀ z h3]
target_source: ∀ (a z : ℂ), ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → ((z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z) + a) / (1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) a * ((z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z))) = z
